$description: Lumen typography primitives. v0.10 — single-typeface system. Satoshi does every job (UI, display, numerics, code, editorial) separated by weight, size, and OpenType feature flags rather than by family. Major Third (1.25) modular scale on a 16px base, extended floor-to-ceiling 11→128px. Leading + tracking are size-conditional curves, not single-bucket aliases. v0.10 retired font.family.mono (JetBrains Mono), font.family.serif (Source Serif 4), and font.family.alt-sans (Inter). v0.13 — $schema lifted to DTCG 2025.10 + the OpenType feature flag catalog under font.features is now first-class so semantic role composites can reference these by name instead of inlining font-feature-settings strings. Geist Mono is exposed as code.fallback only — never the default. See 00-foundations/typography.md and ADR 0017.

sans.$description: The only family. Satoshi Variable (ITF-FFL, 300–900 weight axis, true italic VF). 'Satoshi-Fallback' is a metric-aligned Arial alias defined in globals.css to eliminate CLS on font swap. SF Pro on Apple, Segoe UI Variable on Windows 11, Roboto on Android. v0.10 — Satoshi is now the sole carrier; mono / serif / editorial moments lean on OpenType feature flags (tnum, lnum, zero, calt, liga, ss01-04, case) rather than separate families.

weight.$description: Five-weight stack. Light (300) deprecated in v0.5 — operator-confident voice does not suit thin. The Satoshi VF wght axis is 300–900; intermediate values (440, 510) are available for variable-aware components.

medium.$description: UI labels, tabs, button text, eyebrows, mono captions

extrabold.$description: Optional. display.2xl/hero only, when extra heft is wanted without going to Black.

black.$description: Reserved for display.hero (128px) brutalist treatment. Never body, never sub-display.

axis.$description: Variable-axis weight values for components that compose Satoshi VF directly. Use these for non-integer micro-tunes that don't warrant a static weight token.

body.$description: Body-emphasis. Slightly heavier than Regular (400) for dense reading at 14–16px. Linear-pattern: nudges body without committing to Medium.

body-strong.$description: Inline-emphasis weight. <strong> in body. Sits between Medium (500) and Semibold (600).

size.$description: Major Third (1.25) modular scale on a 16px base, with intermediate stops added for cross-platform precision. Each step is rendered as rem in the output (16px = 1rem). Display ceiling at 128px honors the v0.4 brutalist intent.

11.$description: kbd glyphs, dense legal lines. WCAG floor — use only on neutral backgrounds with ≥ 4.5:1 contrast.

12.$description: Eyebrow caps, micro labels, chart axis. Lumen UI floor for normal text.

13.$description: Caption, secondary table cells, h6. Code block default.

14.$description: Body small, button label default, tab default.

16.$description: Body default. iOS minimum to prevent zoom-on-focus.

17.$description: h4, lead paragraph. Apple HIG body parity.

18.$description: Body large, marketing lead. Butterick lower-bound for screen reading.

20.$description: h3, prose lead. Apple optical-size threshold — at 20px and above, switch to display tracking.

22.$description: Block quote large. Mid-point bridge between h3 and h2.

28.$description: display.sm. Bridge between h1 and display.md.

36.$description: Mid-display. Pairs with body lead at 18px.

56.$description: Hero CTA control height parity. Bridges 49 → 61.

128.$description: display.hero. v0.4 'STOP RE-DESIGNING' brutalist ceiling. Reserved for one-word brand statements.

leading.$description: Size-conditional leading curve. Display tightens as size grows; body relaxes for screen comfort. Each value is grid-aligned to the 4px baseline at its target size. Apply via the per-tier semantic preset rather than picking aliases ad-hoc.

tight-table.$description: Dense table row. Reserved for compact data UI.

uppercase.$description: All-caps eyebrow, overline. Caps-only runs need slightly looser leading than mixed-case to avoid stacking.

ui.$description: h4/h5/h6, caption, label tiers. UI rhythm.

normal.$description: Body (16px). Peer consensus default for screen body.

body-comfortable.$description: Body sm/md and body lg. Per-size tuning above 1.50 for comfort.

relaxed.$description: Longform prose (Satoshi at editorial scale). Editorial reading rhythm — wider than UI body to slow the eye.

loose.$description: Reserved. Not used in current presets.

tracking.$description: Continuous letter-spacing curve mapped to size. Asymptote at -0.025em (Inter formula convergence; pushing tighter has no benefit). Below 14px, tracking goes positive for legibility. The `cap-*` tracks are designed for uppercase runs; the `mono-cap` is the system-metadata signature.

tight-micro.$description: h3 (20px). Subtle compensation at the optical-size threshold.

cap-eyebrow.$description: Sans uppercase eyebrow at 12px. Butterick band 0.05–0.12em compliant.

cap-overline.$description: Light all-caps tracking — chart axis labels, secondary uppercase.

cap-mono.$description: Wide uppercase tracked. The v0.4 system-metadata signature ('SYSTEM V0.10 LIVE'). v0.10 — paired with Satoshi (calt off + tnum on) instead of a separate mono family.

features.$description: v0.13 NEW — OpenType feature flag catalog. Bind to semantic role composites via $extensions.lumen.features (array of feature keys). Renders as CSS font-feature-settings. The catalog is exhaustive for Satoshi VF; semantic roles compose subsets. Mono-uppercase signature label = [cap-mono, tnum, calt-off]; numerics = [tnum, lnum, zero]; body = [pnum, calt]; display = [ss01, case]; italic accent word = [italic, ss01].

tnum.$description: Tabular numerics — column alignment. ALL numeric UI uses this.

lnum.$description: Lining numerics — uppercase-aligned figures. Pairs with tnum for data dashboards.

zero.$description: Slashed zero — disambiguates 0 vs O in dense ops data + monitoring panels.

case.$description: Case-sensitive forms — repositions punctuation around caps (parentheses, hyphens, brackets).

pnum.$description: Proportional numerics — natural-width figures for body prose where alignment doesn't matter.

calt.$description: Contextual alternates — Satoshi default; turn OFF for mono-uppercase signature.

calt-off.$description: Contextual alternates disabled — mono-uppercase tracked label requires this.

ss01.$description: Stylistic Set 1 — Satoshi alternate letterforms (signature numerals).

italic.$description: Variable italic axis — Satoshi VF true italic, value 0–1. Used for the one italic accent word per hero.

code-fallback.$description: v0.13 NEW — code.fallback alias. Geist Mono ONLY surfaces when a consumer explicitly opts a code block out of the Satoshi tabular-numeric monospace contract (rare — usually for parity with a hosted SDK's docs). NEVER the default. The Lumen code surface uses Satoshi + tnum + zero + cap-mono tracking per the v0.10 single-typeface contract.
